ID_HINTCHARACTERS_SPECIALS_NT_01: The Caphex Spy's SCANNER BEACON ability can be retriggered to call in an orbital strike if placed outdoors.
ID_HINTCHARACTERS_SPECIALS_NT_02: The First Order Jet Trooper can hover by holding ZOOM while in air.
ID_HINTCHARACTERS_SPECIALS_NT_03: The First Order Jet Trooper can take off by either pressing the left ability button, or by holding JUMP.
ID_HINTCHARACTERS_SPECIALS_OT_01: The ISB Agent has a series of very fast and nimble melee attacks that allow her to quickly close in on her enemies.
ID_HINTCHARACTERS_SPECIALS_OT_02: While sprinting at full speed with ASSAULT TRANING active, the ISB Agent takes reduced damage.
ID_HINTCHARACTERS_SPECIALS_OT_03: The ISB AGENT regains a portion of health with each melee kill.
ID_HINTCHARACTERS_SPECIALS_PREQ_007: The EWOK HUNTER will automatically find targets to shoot at with its bow.
ID_HINTCHARACTERS_SPECIALS_PREQ_008: The EWOK HUNTER can aim manually and build more power with the bow while zooming.
ID_HINTCHARACTERS_SPECIALS_PREQ_009: When staying crouched, the EWOK HUNTER gains faster recharge speed on all abilities.
ID_HINTCHARACTERS_SPECIALS_PREQ_010: Listen for the EWOK HUNTER voice line indicating full bow power when in zoomed mode.
